faq.How do I get my files?: Right after checkout you receive a download link by email and on the order page. Edit this to match your checkout provider.
faq.Will I receive a physical item?: No. Everything in this shop is a digital file you print or use yourself, unless a listing says otherwise.
faq.How do custom portraits work?: Choose your options, check out, then email your photos. You receive a proof, can ask for one revision, and then get the final files.
faq.Can I sell items I make with your files?: It depends on the licence in each listing. Personal licences cover your own use and gifts; business licences allow selling finished physical items. Reselling the files is never allowed.
faq.What is your refund policy?: Write your refund policy for digital files and custom orders here.
faq.Do you use AI to make your designs?: Describe how your designs are made. If you use AI tools, say so here and in each listing.
